info.title: Sandbox Control Plane API
info.description: Versioned v1 route and transport contract. Resource schemas remain additive during the v0.5 GA candidate.

runnerDevice.name: x-sandbox-signature
runnerDevice.description: Ed25519 signature accompanied by runner ID, key ID, timestamp, and nonce headers.

CorrelationId.name: x-correlation-id
CorrelationId.description: Caller-supplied correlation ID; the server generates one when omitted.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Enables exact replay for mutating requests for 24 hours.

IdempotencyReplayed.description: Present only when the response was replayed.

JsonValue.description: JSON value for a route whose resource schema is not yet promoted to the stable contract.

token.description: Secret returned only on issuance or exact encrypted idempotent replay.
